name: hero-video-dialog
title: Hero Video Dialog
blurb: Video thumbnail with a play button that opens a fullscreen modal with the video…
description: Displays a thumbnail image with an animated play button overlay. Click to open a modal with the embedded video (iframe). Modal animates in from configurable directions and dismisses on close button or Escape key.
use_when: Hero sections or feature cards showcasing product demos or testimonials.
avoid_when: When video must play inline without modal, or for mobile where fullscreen is default.
a11y: Play button is semantic <button>. Modal has close button and Escape key support. Video iframe allows full browser controls.
